messages:
Devin: Quick postmortem note from today's canary: streaming large models with many tiny micro-shards caused excessive mmap churn and high page-fault rates. Thinking about supporting a manifest-level "concat_hint" so loaders can either request a concatenated range from origin or do a cheap in-memory concat descriptor for zero-copy mapping.
Maya: Explain the two modes?
Devin: Mode A: origin/ingest produces a concatenated view (range-request friendly) and manifest sets concat_hint=origin. Mode B: origin doesn't change; loader builds an in-memory concat descriptor that maps logical offsets to underlying shards and performs zero-copy remap if shards are back-to-back on disk or same object store.
Sparrow: Mode B sounds promising but we need safety: only allow zero-copy remap if shards are contiguous and chunk-aligned. Add fields: "chunk_alignment": 4096 and "zero_copy_safe": true on shard entries. Loader falls back to staged read if not safe.
Chao: Another edge: compressed micro-shards (zstd) can't be remapped. Add "compressed":true flag per shard and then manifest should include an "uncompressed_size_hint" so prefetch budgeting works.
Devin: Proposed manifest snippet:
```json
{"shards": [
  {"path":"m.000","offset":0,"len":524288,"chunk_alignment":4096,"zero_copy_safe":true},
  {"path":"m.001","offset":0,"len":32768,"compressed":true,"uncompressed_size_hint":262144}
] , "concat_hint":"origin" }
```
Maya: Telemetry: emit concat.requests, concat.fallbacks, mmap.pagefaults. ops-bot can you file a dashboard ticket?
ops-bot: Filed INF-7012: "concat_hint & zero_copy mapping metrics" (will emit shard.concat.requests, shard.concat.fallbacks, mmap.pagefaults.p95).
Sparrow: Loader impl detail: try zero-copy remap only for shards with identical object IDs and adjacent offsets. If remap fails, fall back to a single staged prefetch and then create an ephemeral consolidated mmap to serve reads.
Chao: For Hosted, we should prefer origin concat to reduce client CPU. For Dedicated, allow loader concat to optimize for local SSD layouts. Add manifest-level "concat_preference": "origin|loader|any".
Devin: Back compat: default behavior = any (current behavior).
Maya: Action items: Devin add manifest fields RFC; Sparrow prototype loader concat descriptor + remap; Chao add sim for compressed vs uncompressed mixes; ops-bot will wire metrics.
Devin: I'll open the RFC tonight.
Maya: Thanks all. Small change but should tame page-fault storms. :thumbsup:
